_comment: Cash in the Prime Minister's Disaster Relief Fund. The 12 Bhadra nine-bank table (Rs 6,553,362,011) plus 15 Bhadra receipts (Rs 600,220,106) close at Rs 7,153,582,117. The bulletin at nirajbhusal.github.io is someone else's aggregation; the Ministry of Finance / PMDRF figures are the source. Two rules: (1) the pre-disaster balance is already inside the 7.15 billion — never add it again; (2) PhonePe QR, foreign pledges, in-kind cargo and the IFRC DREF are not this fund and are never added to it. app/domains/flood/content.py re-adds the bank rows at load.

headline.label_en: In the PM Disaster Relief Fund
Already in the fund before the flood

breakdowns.caption_en: Nine banks, 12 Bhadra (Rs 6.55 billion) plus 15 Bhadra receipts (Rs 600 million) = Rs 7.15 billion. That equals 4.98 billion collected after the flood plus 2.17 billion already held. The USD line is a separate label.
breakdowns.caption_ne: नौ बैंक, १२ भदौ (रु. ६ अर्ब ५५ करोड) + १५ भदौ (रु. ६० करोड २ लाख) = रु. ७ अर्ब १५ करोड। विपद्पछि ४ अर्ब ९८ करोड + मौज्दात २ अर्ब १७ करोड। डलर छुट्टै लेबल हो।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: The 2.17 billion already in the fund is inside the 7.15 billion, not on top of it. USD 3.19 million is not part of the Nepali-rupee total. PhonePe QR Rs 1.97 billion, foreign pledges, World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC appeal are not this fund.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: विपद्अघिको २ अर्ब १७ करोड ७ अर्ब १५ करोडभित्र छ, माथि होइन। डलर ३१.९ लाख नेपाली जम्मामा होइन। फोनपे QR रु. १ अर्ब ९६ करोड, वैदेशिक घोषणा, विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी अपिल यो कोष होइनन्।

aside.label_en: USD account (~Rs 48.6 crore at NRB 152.57, 28 Aug)

breakdowns.caption_en: UK $6.79m + US $3.6m + OCHA $3.2m + South Korea $1m + ADB $5m + UAE $10m. These are pledges, not cash in the Prime Minister's fund.
breakdowns.caption_ne: बेलायत $६.७९ मि. + अमेरिका $३.६ मि. + ओसीएचए $३.२ मि. + दक्षिण कोरिया $१ मि. + एडीबी $५ मि. + युएई $१० मि.। घोषणा हुन्, प्रधानमन्त्री कोषमा आएको नगद होइनन्।
breakdowns.do_not_merge_en: Not added to the Rs 7.15 billion. World Bank Rs 25 billion and the IFRC CHF 25 million appeal are separate lines, not inside this $29.59 million. ADB $5m and UAE $10m are pledges, not cash received. UAE's 83-tonne flight is inside the $10m package, not on top of it.
breakdowns.do_not_merge_ne: रु. ७ अर्ब १५ करोडमा जोडिँदैन। विश्व बैंक २५ अर्ब र आईएफआरसी CHF २५ मिलियन अपिल यो $२९.५९ मिलियनभित्र होइनन्। एडीबी $५ मिलियन र युएई $१० मिलियन घोषणा हुन्, आएको नगद होइनन्। युएईको ८३ टन उडान $१० मिलियनभित्र छ, माथि होइन।

exclusive.detail_en: 10 tonnes then 37.5 tonnes. In-kind, not cash. Transfer at Tribhuvan not confirmed.

exclusive.label_en: PM fund: Rs 1 billion to be sent to affected areas
exclusive.label_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री कोष: प्रभावित क्षेत्रमा एक अर्ब पठाइने
exclusive.detail_en: OPMCM, 16 Bhadra — the fund operating committee decided to send Rs 1 billion immediately. That is money leaving the fund, not extra cash on top of the Rs 7.15 billion already in the banks.
exclusive.detail_ne: प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालय, १६ भदौ — कोष सञ्चालन समितिले एक अर्ब तत्काल पठाउने निर्णय गरेको। यो कोषबाट बाहिरिने रकम हो, बैंकमा रहेको ७ अर्ब १५ करोडमाथि थप होइन।

exclusive.detail_en: MoHA monsoon command, 16 Bhadra — Rasuwa, Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha and Tanahun palikas. Matches the 11 Bhadra DRRM executive-committee allocation; count once. Not the PM fund cash total. 75+100+30+20 + 150+75+25+50 + 30+20+20+20 + 20 + 20+20 = 675 lakh.
exclusive.detail_ne: गृह, मनसुन कमाण्ड, १६ भदौ — रसुवा, नुवाकोट, धादिङ, गोरखा र तनहुँका पालिका। ११ भदौको विपद् कार्यकारी समितिको विनियोजनसँग मेल; एक पटक मात्र गन्नुहोस्। प्रधानमन्त्री कोषको मौज्दात होइन। ७५+१००+३०+२० + १५०+७५+२५+५० + ३०+२०+२०+२० + २० + २०+२० = ६७५ लाख।
